issuer.about: the local dev Owner (pnpm run dev:owner); issues every magic link because MJ lets an Owner issue invites (CanIssueInvites) and its Developer role may create MJ: Magic Link Invites rows. No credentialing role may create invite rows in B1 (docs/isolation-read-paths.md).

staff-a.about: Credentialing Staff, member of the sample accrediting body A

staff-b.about: Credentialing Staff, member of the sample accrediting body B

staff-none.about: Credentialing Staff with no organization membership

admin.about: Credentialing Admin; sets up accrediting organizations

applicant-a.about: external applicant; contact of Sample Applicant One only

applicant-two.about: external applicant; contact of both Sample Applicant One and Sample Applicant Two (for the subject picker)

applicant-evidence.about: external applicant; contact of Sample Evidence Applicant (Sample Evidence Program with Normal and Restricted Allowed requirements)

reviewer-a.about: external reviewer; the first redemption creates the account with the role and the application row

committee-a.about: external committee member; the first redemption creates the account with the role and the application row
